newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures begin mixed, little-changed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures begin mixed, little-changed.

text.p: April 16 - IMM currency futures began pit trading mixed, most little-changed. Futures showed scant response to 6.4-pct drop in March US housing starts to 1.425 million unit rate vs forecasts for 1.46 million units. Yen edged up overnight, still undergirded by intervention concerns. MoF's Sakakibara reiterated that yen moves excessive, said Japan will intervene when can "win."
